title.en: An Act Creating Certain Barrios in the Municipality of Quezon, Province of Palawan
title.orig: An Act Creating Certain Barrios in the Municipality of Quezon, Province of Palawan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2225_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
The following sitios in the Municipality of Quezon, Province of Palawan, are constituted into barrios, to wit:
1. The sitios of Punta Baja and Malabunga to be known as the barrio of Punta Baja; and
2. The sitios of Maasin and Iwahig to be known as the barrio of Maasin.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
